newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mexico ups Oct Maya price to Asia, Isthmus steady.
newsitem.headline: Mexico ups Oct Maya price to Asia, Isthmus steady.

text.p: Mexico has raised the price formula for its October-lifting Maya crude oil to Asia by 10 cents per barrel, but kept the price of Isthmus crude steady from the previous month, traders said on Tuesday.
October Maya was raised by 10 cents from the September price to the average of Oman and Dubai quotations minus $2.60 a barrel, traders said.
October-lifting Isthmus was unchanged from the previous month's price of the average of Oman and Dubai quotations plus 55 cents, they said.
